stepByStepTour.guides.home.create.descri: Click here to make it yours
stepByStepTour.guides.home.noCreate.desc: You can review lessons here and learn how Dify works. To create an app from a lesson, switch to a workspace where you have create permission, or contact your Workspace Owner or Admin.
stepByStepTour.guides.home.pick.descript: Pick a lesson to see how it works.
stepByStepTour.guides.integration.dataSo: Connect data sources here so Knowledge can bring in content from Drive, Notion, GitHub, Firecrawl, and more.
stepByStepTour.guides.integration.limite: Connect data sources here so Knowledge can import content from Drive, Notion, GitHub, Firecrawl, and more. To set them up, switch to a workspace where you have permission, or contact your Workspace Owner or Admin.
View connected MCP servers that expose external tools and services to apps. To add or edit servers, switch to a workspace where you have permission, or contact your Workspace Owner or Admin.
View model providers, model credentials, and Message Credits here. To install or change providers, contact your Workspace Owner or Admin.
Browse installed tools and Marketplace plugins that apps can call during execution. To install or configure one, contact your Workspace Owner or Admin.
View triggers that turn third-party events into app inputs. To create or manage triggers, switch to a workspace where you have permission, or contact your Workspace Owner or Admin.
stepByStepTour.guides.integration.mcp.de: Connect MCP servers when your apps need access to external tools and services through MCP.
stepByStepTour.guides.integration.modelP: Manage or install model providers here, set up model credentials, and check your Message Credits.
stepByStepTour.guides.integration.toolPl: Manage built-in tools and marketplace plugins that apps can call during execution.
stepByStepTour.guides.integration.trigge: Use triggers to turn third-party events into inputs your apps can recognize and act on automatically.
stepByStepTour.guides.integration.update: Configure how integrations update automatically, including the update mode, scheduled time, and which integrations are included.
stepByStepTour.guides.knowledge.empty.co: Already have a knowledge base elsewhere? Connect it via API — no data migration needed.
Connect to an external knowledge base
stepByStepTour.guides.knowledge.empty.cr: Fastest way to get going. Upload documents and Dify handles chunking, indexing, and embedding for you. You can switch to custom anytime.
stepByStepTour.guides.knowledge.empty.pi: Define your own chunking, cleanup, and indexing flow when you need finer control over how documents become searchable.
stepByStepTour.guides.knowledge.withData: Use Create to add a new knowledge base — start ready-to-use, build a custom one from your documents, or connect to an external knowledge base.
Tap any knowledge base to open its document management page — update documents, retrieval settings, and access from there.
Open and manage each knowledge base
stepByStepTour.guides.studio.empty.blank: Start from an empty canvas when you already know what to build.
stepByStepTour.guides.studio.empty.dsl.d: Import an app package or DSL file to restore a shared or backed-up app.
stepByStepTour.guides.studio.empty.learn: New to Dify? Walk through a guided lesson first — you'll see Workflows, Agents, and more in action.
stepByStepTour.guides.studio.empty.templ: Browse Dify's templates and pick one that matches what you want to build. Great way to start without writing anything from scratch.
stepByStepTour.guides.studio.noCreate.em: You can view apps in this workspace, but there are no apps here yet. To create or edit apps, switch workspaces or ask your Workspace Owner or Admin for access.
stepByStepTour.guides.studio.noCreate.wi: You can browse apps in this workspace. To create or edit apps, switch to a workspace where you have permission, or contact your Workspace Owner or Admin.
stepByStepTour.guides.studio.withApps.cr: Use Create to add a new app — pick from a template, start from blank, or import an app package or DSL file.
stepByStepTour.guides.studio.withApps.ma: Tap any app to open its orchestration page — edit prompts, models, and logic, or manage its settings from there.
